The '''cowill''' was a type of armored [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="TCSWE" /> the [[Water/Legends|water]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Knights-DB">{{DB|organization|moncalamariknights|Mon Calamari Knights}}</ref> [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. The creatures' shells were the basis of<ref name="TCSWE" /> the [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]-woven [[Shield (physical armor)/Legends|shields]] used by the [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]], legendary protectors of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari's]] [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="Knights-DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cowill was first indirectly mentioned in the "Mon Calamari Knights" entry in the original [[Databank (original)|Databank]],<ref name="Knights-DB" /> added on [[October 22]], [[2003]].<ref name="DB-Date">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20031022.html|text=Inside the Clone Wars}}</ref> Referenced via the description "cowill-shell shield,"<ref name="Knights-DB" /> the cowill was later identified as a specific creature in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2008]] reference book.<ref name="TCSWE" />
